questions.stem: The staff room is (at / in / on) the second floor of the building.
When I saw Hoa, she was holding a pocket English dictionary (at / in / on) her hands.
Is their school (at / in / on) 32 Vo Van Kiet Avenue?
The child is sitting (at / in / on) the classroom...
...looking at the poster (at / in / on) the wall.
Parents usually wait for their children (at / in / on) the school gate...

exercises.instruction: Read the conversation and fill in the gaps with appropriate prepositions of time.
exercises.passage_template:
Mark: I'm sorry I was out when you called yesterday afternoon, Alice. Look, I'm free (1) ____ the fifteenth of March. Can we meet then?
Alice: I'm busy next week, I'm afraid. So, I can't see you (2) ____ Friday.
Mark: I'd like to have a meeting this month if possible because I'll be very busy (3) ____ April.
Alice: I'm going away (4) ____ Easter, so how about the week after? Shall we meet (5) ____ the twenty-seventh? That's a Wednesday.
Mark: OK. Let's meet (6) ____ Wednesday afternoon (7) ____ half past two.

exercises.instruction: Read the conversation and then circle the best option (A, B, or C) to complete each of the sentences.
exercises.passage:
Mai and Phong: Good morning, Mr Lam.
Mr Lam: Good morning. Welcome to Hung Vuong Lower Secondary School.
Mai: Mr Lam, can you tell us something about the school?
Mr Lam: Well, it was founded in 1957. So it's one of the oldest lower secondary schools in the city.
Phong: How many students are there? And what are they like?
Mr Lam: More than two thousand students. Most of them are intelligent and hard-working. They're very active too. They do lots of outdoor activities.
Phong: Sounds really interesting. I wish I could study here.
Mr Lam: Well, to attend the school, you have to pass an entrance exam.
Phong: Yes, I understand ... And ...

questions.stem: Hung Vuong Lower Secondary School is one of the ____ lower secondary schools in the city.
The number of students in the school is ____.
Most of the students are ____.
The students not only study but also do ____.
To attend the school, students have to pass ____.

exercises.instruction: Read the passage and write answers to the questions.
exercises.passage:
Westminster High School is a famous school in England. It is in the heart of London, next to the Houses of Parliament. The school has some modern facilities such as a new sports hall, a golf course, a science centre, a large theatre, and a music centre.
There are 740 students in the school. They are intelligent and hard-working. To attend the school, they have to pass an entrance exam and an interview. All students have to take final exams in science, maths, English, literature, and French or German. They also take part in some outdoor activities such as playing golf, growing flowers or rowing on the Thames.

questions.stem: Where is Westminster High School?
questions.answer: It is in the heart of London, next to the Houses of Parliament.

questions.stem: What facilities does the school have?
questions.answer: It has some modern facilities such as a new sports hall, a golf course, a science centre, a large theatre, and a music centre.

questions.stem: What are the students like?
What do the students have to do to attend the school?
questions.answer: They have to pass an entrance exam and an interview.

questions.stem: What outdoor activities do they take part in?
questions.answer: They take part in some outdoor activities such as playing golf, growing flowers or rowing on the Thames.
